## Education

**PhD in Political Science**, Indiana University Bloomington  
Expected May 2027

Dissertation research examines how housing policies shape pathways to economic security, upward mobility, and political attitudes across advanced democracies.

**Dissertation Committee:** Jason Yuyan Wu (Chair), Nicolas Bichay, Sarah Bauerle Danzman, Arthur S. Alderson (Sociology), and John S. Kuk (Michigan State University; External Member)
